title: Ukuhlolwa Kwesidalwa Esingcwele
intro: Isibonakaliso sathunyelwa esizweni esasiphambukile. Phakathi nokuphila kwabo okunethezekile kwafika isixwayiso—sihambisana nesidalwa esimangalisayo esasizoba uvivinyo olukhulu lokholo lwabo. Impendulo yabo yayizoqinisekisa isiphetho sabo kuze kube phakade. Ungayithola yini ukuthi ubani owaletha lesi sixwayiso nokuthi kwenzekani ngalabo abasilahla?
clues: Sasingabantu ababeholwa yizithunywa zangaphambilini ngaphambi kwethu.
Isidalwa esihle kakhulu savela entabeni, isibonakaliso esivela eNkosini yethu kulesi sizwe.
Ngabatshela: 'Leli ikamela lensikazi elika-Allah, ngakho-ke liyekeni lidle emhlabeni ka-Allah futhi ningalithinti ngokulimaza.'
Kodwa abantu banquma ikamela lami eliyinsikazi, bephula umyalo weNkosi yabo.
Ngiyisithunywa esivela eNkosini yakho kuphela, ngithunywe ngeqiniso—ngingumprofethi nenceku ethembekile.
Ngokuqondene nabenzi bobubi, iNkosi yethu yabashaya ngomsindo odumayo, base bema benganyakazi emakhaya abo.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
